mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) during UNRATE declines below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) indices above their 5-month moving averages signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed their moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting expectations of higher interest rates compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly lower than baseline (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS increases above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both INDPRO (supply) and RSAFS (demand) indices above their 3-month moving averages signals a healthy balance between supply and demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed their moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle labor market expansion, a sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4.5% amplifies positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as improved labor conditions boost consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) during UNRATE declines below 4.5% in late-cycle labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) above its 10-month moving average signals robust business investment and production growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) during INDPRO's upward trend above 10-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling FEDFUNDS rates and rising GDPC1 demand index above their 3-month moving averages signals dual accommodative monetary and demand-driven growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) when both proxies meet the trigger conditions.
